targetWords.definition: To be against something is to be touching it or opposed to it.
targetWords.example: ■They both leaned against the wall.

targetWords.definition: The beach is a sandy or rocky place by the ocean.
targetWords.example: The little girl built a sandcastle on the beach.

targetWords.definition: To damage something is to break it.
targetWords.example: The car was damaged in the accident.

targetWords.definition: To discover something is to find it for the first time.
targetWords.example: ■I discovered some new information in this book!

targetWords.definition: An emotion is how you feel.
targetWords.example: ■Anger is a common emotion that we all feel.

targetWords.definition: To fix something is to make it work.
targetWords.example: My dad has many tools to help him fix broken things.

targetWords.definition: If you are frank, you are being very honest.
targetWords.example: The teacher had a frank discussion with her students.

targetWords.definition: To identify something is to be able to name it.
targetWords.example: I used the file to identify his name.

targetWords.definition: An island is land in the middle of water.
targetWords.example: japan is a group of islands.

targetWords.definition: The ocean is all of the salt water that surrounds land.
targetWords.example: ■The ocean can make powerful waves.

targetWords.definition: Perhaps is used when you say that something could happen.
targetWords.example: Perhaps I will eat an apple for lunch.

targetWords.definition: If something is pleasant, you enjoy it.
targetWords.example: The character had a pleasant look on its face.

targetWords.definition: To prevent something is to stop it from happening.
targetWords.example: The handcuffs prevented me from moving my hands.

targetWords.definition: A rock is a hard thing in the dirt.
targetWords.example: I stacked rocks on top of one another.

targetWords.definition: To save something is to keep it from being hurt.
targetWords.example: I want to help save the world.

targetWords.definition: To step is to walk.
targetWords.example: Be careful where you step.

targetWords.definition: Still is used when you say that a situation keeps going on.
targetWords.example: They are still waiting in line to get tickets.

targetWords.definition: A taste is the flavor something makes in your mouth.
targetWords.example: The taste of the fruit was sweet.

targetWords.definition: To throw something is to use your hand to make it go through the air.
targetWords.example: ■The pitcher can throw the baseball very fast.

targetWords.definition: A wave is a line of water that moves higher than the rest of the water.
targetWords.example: The water was filled with large blue waves. 57

story.title: The Starfish
story.passage:
Last summer I took a trip to an island. I had a lot of fun. I sat and watched the

waves and listened to the ocean. I learned to identify birds. I discovered pretty

things and enjoyed the taste of new foods. It was a very nice time.

One evening I took a pleasant walk by the ocean. When the waves came in,

many starfish* fell on the beach. Some starfish went back into the water, and

they were safe. But other starfish were still on the sand. They would die if they

did not get into the water. There were many starfish on the beach that night. It

made me sad, but I knew I could not fix the problem. I stepped very carefully so

I did not damage them.

Then I saw a little girl. She was also sad about the starfish. She wanted to

prevent all of them from dying. She asked me if I could perhaps help her.

"To be frank, I don't think we can do anything," I said.

The little girl started to cry. She sat back against a rock and thought for a

while. Finally, the emotion was gone. She stopped crying and stood up. Then

she picked up a starfish and threw it into the water.

"What are you doing?" I asked her. But she did not answer me. She just threw

as many starfish as she could. "You cannot save all of them!" I said.

She stopped to look at me. " No, I cannot save them all," she replied. Then

she picked up a very big starfish and said, " But I can save

this one." And then she smiled and threw the starfish as

far as she could into the ocean.

*starfish - an animal shaped like a star that lives in the water
